exposure: Induction of labor with balloon catheter
cohort: Women with one previous Cesarean section and an unfavorable cervix undergoing induction of labor
finding: Orally administered Cytotec® and balloon catheter for induction of labor in women with one previous Cesarean section and an unfavorable cervix resulted in similar rates of uterine rupture.
mod_finding: Orally administered Cytotec® and balloon catheter for induction of labor in women with one previous Cesarean section and an unfavorable cervix resulted in similar high success rates of vaginal deliveries (almost 70%).
